items.title: Clashing Through the Snow
items.overview: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.

items.title: Holy Wood Dust
items.overview: Every winter, millions of fir trees are chopped down, admired, and thrown away. The film follows their journey above and below ground, from human rituals to the hidden life inside the trees. A story about trees that we celebrate by cutting them down.

items.title: Focker In-Law
items.overview: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

items.title: Hexed
items.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

items.title: A Few Days in the Sun
items.overview: A European couple's vacation abruptly ends when they're kidnapped in Mexico. A working-class Mexican family is compelled to imprison them, leading to an unexpected cultural clash.

items.title: 24 Türchen zu dir
items.overview: Liv just wants to break out of her daily routine for once and go on vacation with her husband Anton and son Basti. But even just before Christmas, Anton can’t make her wish come true. That’s because working at his father Franz’s mountain cabin keeps the whole family tied up around the clocks, 24/7—with no end in sight. And because Anton can’t even manage a small gesture like an Advent calendar, Liv takes a stand and moves in with her friend Sigi. It’s a message Anton understands: with a homemade Advent calendar, he tries to win Liv back—and hides something very special behind the first door.

items.title: Tun und Lassen
items.overview: Einblick in eine Berliner Suchtklinik, in der Menschen zwischen 20 und 60 Jahren an ihrer Rückkehr in ein suchtfreies Leben arbeiten.

items.title: Santaphobia
items.overview: In 2019, the morbid, mangled bodies of filmmaker Emma Thomas (Lizzie Aaryn-Stanton) and her girlfriend Lauren White (Katie Martin) are discovered in the woods following a night at the notorious ‘Satan’s Grotto’ – a festive attraction that was home to a horrific holiday massacre in the early 1980s.  A paranormal researcher (Emily Booth) presents the recovered recordings, narrating the footage as the two girls, and Emma’s father (Cory Peterson), embark on their perilous journey through the grisly grotto. At first all seems swell as they wander through the wicked winter wonderland, but when a mysterious figure appears on screen and her father disappears, Emma’s skepticism turns to obsession. Desperate to uncover the truth, Emma’s reality unravels as she discovers she’s trapped in an endless Christmas Day loop, where madness and violence are inescapable.

items.title: Brute 1986
items.overview: Leather Kobra, a glam metal band, film a music video in an abandoned Western town. Unfortunately the ultra violent Birdy family lives nearby and their paths cross in an onslaught of brutal bloodshed.

items.title: Dasher
items.overview: Dasher is a 2026 Disney Jr. holiday special that tells the origin story of Santa's reindeer, focusing on a brave little doe named Dasher who escapes a traveling circus, helps Santa's sleigh, and eventually joins his team of reindeer.

items.title: Sarathi
items.overview: A young man torn between his own dreams and his duty to his ailing mother must confront what it truly means to love, sacrifice, and let go.

items.title: Ben'imana
items.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.
